title: Balanced Discourse Contrast: míg ... addig and ezzel szemben

sections.title: Parallel Antithesis with míg ... addig
sections.content: When Hungarian writers contrast two simultaneous historical realities or opposing ideological stances within a single complex sentence, they pair míg ('while / whereas') in the first clause with addig ('by contrast / meanwhile') at the head of the second clause. Unlike English, where 'while' suffices alone, Hungarian B2 prose strongly favors explicit correlative balancing with addig.

sections.title: Inter-sentential Pivot with ezzel szemben
sections.content: Across sentence boundaries, ezzel szemben ('in contrast to this / opposed to this') links a new sentence back to the entire proposition of the preceding sentence. It typically stands either sentence-initially or immediately after the new contrastive topic (e.g., Ignotus ezzel szemben amellett érvelt, hogy...).

sections.title: Correlative and Discourse Contrast Connectors
rows: Míg az akadémiai kritika a múltat védte, addig a Nyugat a jövőt kereste.
Whereas academic criticism defended the past, Nyugat sought the future.
Míg a napilapok tízezres példányszámban fogytak, addig a folyóirat szűkebb réteghez szólt.
While dailies sold in tens of thousands, the journal addressed a narrower stratum.
A konzervatívok bezárkózást sürgettek. A modernisták ezzel szemben nyitottságot hirdettek.
Conservatives urged isolation. Modernists, by contrast, proclaimed openness.

items.spanish: Míg a hivatalos kritika a hagyomány ismétlését várta el, addig a Nyugat az alkotói szabadságot hirdette.
items.english: Whereas official criticism expected the repetition of tradition, Nyugat proclaimed creative freedom.

items.spanish: A konzervatív lapok kozmopolitizmussal vádolták őket. Ignotus ezzel szemben a nemzeti irodalom megújításáról írt.
items.english: Conservative papers accused them of cosmopolitanism. Ignotus, by contrast, wrote about renewing national literature.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Always place a comma before addig when it introduces the second clause of a míg ... addig correlative structure.
